title: malus communis subsp. pumila
intro: Malus communis subsp. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Crabapple, is a subspecies of the Malus communis species, native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Crabapple are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
